legacy-source-checkpoint.scope: The historical 812c4339 artifact may lack direct tree/native NDU body evidence; each absence is explicitly unavailable and unverified.

requires: Actual source-tree.txt member bytes match the expected tree ID.
Its complete read byte count matches ZIP metadata, it has ELF magic, and SHA256 matches manifest.binary_sha256 plus built_binary_sha256 when present.

required_checks: Actual source-sha.txt bytes and regression git_base equal expected commit.
Local immutable Git commit object hashes to expected commit and binds expected tree; tree object bytes also hash correctly.
All recorded source bindings match immutable commit blobs; regression inventory and module list match the frozen qualifier definition.
Every declared round4 continuation/assembly/assignment/routes/sealed-identity/session-cost test is present as ok in the actual regression log.
Every required result is present with its known exact schema and positive implementation status; missing, malformed, errored or skipped results fail.
Continuation actual native prefix, version change, same owner, exact suffix, independent arithmetic, zero replay, known costs and balanced resources.
Assembly canonical representations, 81 VM pairs, 24 native values, refusal of unknown opcode, source bindings and actual archived native bytes.
Both assignment variants, complete declaration accounting, native/reference/oracle agreement, actual target bytes, missing-drop rejection and executed wrong-order lifecycle negative controls.
Selected ZIP members are fully read for CRC and SHA; no filesystem extraction or archive program execution.
All failed report fields, failed episodes, failed observations, missing evidence and audit errors are retained in the new output.
remaining_unknown_until_authorized_membe: Actual source-sha.txt member payload; its path and 41-byte size are known only from the central directory.
Actual report JSON payload values, before/after claims, source bindings, artifact receipts and failure details.
Native artifact byte hashes and per-member CRC outcomes.
Whether all frozen-source regression log entries meet the exact observed unittest format.
known_limits: The historical 812c4339 artifact has no direct CI tree receipt. Git commit/tree correlation is reported separately. The later final workflow adds source-tree.txt; final mode requires its actual member bytes.
The standalone continuation CLI defaults to prefix 6/40. Cross-item prefix 22/40 is covered by the actual regression test, not an invented second standalone output directory.

The historical 812c4339 upload contains the native NDU build identity manifest without its executable. Legacy mode leaves the body unavailable. The later final workflow uploads the executable; final mode requires matching actual ELF bytes.
Run/job terminal status needs the separately retained GitHub metadata and decoded log; artifact readout alone does not establish it.
Passing implementation evidence does not change performance, NDU economics or Agent study gates.
Complete member payload reading, decompression and script execution remain deferred until the coordinator confirms all model work has ended.
